definitions.explanation: Items that come with or can be added to a main product, such as cables, adapters, cases, or other supplementary components.

examples.japanese: {付属品|ふぞくひん}を{確認|かくにん}してください。
この{製品|せいひん}には{充電|じゅうでん}ケーブルが{付属品|ふぞくひん}として{付|つ}いている。
examples.english: This product comes with a charging cable as an accessory.

examples.japanese: {中古|ちゅうこ}で{買|か}ったので{付属品|ふぞくひん}が{一部|いちぶ}{欠|か}けていた。
examples.english: Since I bought it secondhand, some of the accessories were missing.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly used in product descriptions, manuals, and shopping contexts. Distinct from {部品|ぶひん} (parts/components), which refers to internal components rather than supplementary items.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {付属品|ふぞくひん}を{確認|かくにん}する (to check the accessories)
- {付属品|ふぞくひん}{一覧|いちらん} (list of included accessories)
- {付属品|ふぞくひん}なし (without accessories)
- {付属品|ふぞくひん}が{揃|そろ}っている (all accessories are included)
